items.raw_excerpt: New Taipei Mayor Hou Yu-ih (侯友宜) said Tuesday that the MRT Sanying Line will begin operating its full daily schedule, from 6 a.m. to midnight, on Aug. 16, while continuing to offer free rides during the trial period.
items.summary_en: New Taipei Mayor Hou Yu-ih said the MRT Sanying Line will run its full daily schedule from Aug. 16. Trains will operate from 6 a.m. to midnight. Rides will remain free during the trial period.
items.summary_ko: 신베이시 후여이 시장은 싼잉선이 8월 16일부터 전 시간대 정규 운행을 시작한다고 밝혔다. 열차는 오전 6시부터 자정까지 운행한다. 시험 운행 기간에는 계속 무료로 탈 수 있다.
items.title_en: Metro Sanying Line to run full hours from Sunday, stay free
items.title_ko: 신베이 지하철 싼잉선, 8월 16일부터 전시간대 운행… 체험 기간 무료 이어져
items.title_original: Metro Sanying Line to operate full hours from Sunday, remain free

items.raw_excerpt: The utility says it is currently managing about 3 000 open calls
items.summary_en: City Power is the electricity provider in Johannesburg. It is now managing about 3,000 open calls. The utility asks residents to use less electricity to ease pressure on the network.

items.raw_excerpt: A fresh debate about whether foreigners should be able to speak German in the service industry has been reignited following a post from a cafe in Munich that defended staff over their language skills.
items.summary_en: A cafe in Munich posted a message that defended its staff over their language skills. The post became popular online and started a new debate. People are arguing again about whether foreigners should speak German in the service industry.
items.summary_ko: 뮌헨의 한 카페가 직원들의 언어 실력을 감싸는 글을 올려 온라인에서 큰 화제가 됐다. 이 글이 서비스 업계에서 외국인이 독일어를 써야 하는지에 대한 새로운 논쟁을 불러일으켰다. 사람들은 일터에서 독일어 사용이 의무여야 하는지를 두고 다시 의견을 나누고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: Consumer protection authorities in several regions in Spain have ordered the recall of six models of eclipse glasses due to the potential risk of eye damage.
items.summary_en: Consumer protection agencies in several Spanish regions ordered a recall of six models of eclipse glasses. The glasses may cause damage to the eyes. The recall was ordered because of the risk of eye injury.

items.raw_excerpt: If weekend flea markets are a favourite pastime, this expression will likely come in handy. And if flea markets aren't your thing, here's a funny expression for you to learn.
items.summary_en: The Danish phrase 'at prutte om prisen' means to bargain about the price. It is a handy expression if you love weekend flea markets. It is also a funny expression to learn even if flea markets are not your thing.

items.raw_excerpt: This beginner-level adjective can actually make you sound like a more experienced German speaker if you use it as slang.
items.summary_en: Sauber is a beginner-level German adjective meaning clean. German speakers also use it as slang to mean great or cool. Using it this way can make you sound like a more experienced speaker.

items.raw_excerpt: More than a thousand people on Newfoundland’s west coast are without power — and it will be midnight before it's restored.

items.raw_excerpt: Even as the Mysuru City Corporation (MCC) is inching towards turning 80 garbage spots in the city trash-free to mark the 80th Independence Day, the bigger challenge before the civic body is to ensure that these cleaned and transformed spots do not turn into dumping grounds again once the drive is over.

items.raw_excerpt: The campaign seeks to remember the past while delivering the future
